name: Torino Football Club
notes: Torino reports on a calendar year; 2025 revenue (valore della produzione EUR 122.5m) includes player trading. Net loss for 2025 EUR 13.105m ("perdita di periodo di Euro 13.105 mila"). Net debt from the reclassified balance sheet (EUR thousands 42,600); evidence quotes the row label. Cairo's acquisition (2 September 2005, per club history page: "ufficialmente acquisito da Cairo il 2 settembre") predates 2015 so is not a deal row. The albo d'oro lists 1927-28, 1942-43 and 1945-46 to 1948-49 and 1975-76 scudetti plus a revoked 1926-27 title, but no page states a total, so honours left null. Stadium owner (City of Turin) not confirmed on a page read. No valuation, socials, sponsor/kit or CEO found (no CEO role on the organigramma). No institutional equity investors.
